snippet.title: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Dive into the haunting beauty of Tsarevna's main theme, composed by Alexander Billione, performed live by the Opensound Orchestra and conducted by Stanislav Malyshev. Experience the passion and craftsmanship that brought this dark Slavic fairy tale to life.

TSAREVNA. Age of Tales. Where ballet becomes a weapon.

Wishlist TSAREVNA on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348640/TSAREVNA_Age_of_Tales/
